meaning.en: The night sky dotted with many stars.

examples.zh: 夜晚，天空繁星点点。
examples.en: At night the sky is dotted with stars.

examples.zh: 繁星点点的夜空，让人想起童年的夏夜。
examples.en: The star-studded sky recalls summer nights from childhood.

examples.zh: 我们躺在草地上，看着繁星点点。
examples.en: We lay on the grass watching the stars twinkle.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; frequent in school essays on night scenes.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，作文中描写夜景时常见。

meaning.en: The wide, wintry scenery of northern China.
meaning.zh: 中国北方辽阔壮美的冰雪风光。

examples.zh: 北国风光，千里冰封，万里雪飘。
examples.en: Northern scenery: a thousand li of ice, ten thousand li of drifting snow.

examples.zh: 摄影师专程去哈尔滨拍北国风光。
examples.en: The photographer went to Harbin to shoot the northern landscape.

examples.zh: 北国风光与江南风光各有千秋。
examples.en: The scenery of the north and of the south each have their charm.

story.en: The opening of Mao Zedong's 1936 poem 'Snow': 'Northern scenery: a thousand li of ice, ten thousand li of snowflakes'.
story.zh: 毛泽东1936年《沁园春·雪》开篇：“北国风光，千里冰封，万里雪飘。”

usage.en: Often evokes snow and wide spaces; contrast with 江南水乡.
usage.zh: 常令人联想到冰雪和辽阔；与“江南水乡”相对。

meaning.en: Vast frontier scenery of the northern grasslands and deserts, beyond the passes.
meaning.zh: 长城以北边塞地区的苍茫风光。

examples.zh: 塞外风光，大漠孤烟，长河落日。
examples.en: Frontier scenery: lone smoke over the desert and a setting sun over the long river.

examples.zh: 他们去内蒙古领略塞外风光。
examples.en: They went to Inner Mongolia to enjoy the frontier landscape.

examples.zh: 塞外风光与江南风光截然不同。
examples.en: The scenery beyond the Wall is utterly unlike that of the south.

usage.en: Evokes grasslands, deserts and desolate grandeur.
usage.zh: 常令人联想到草原、大漠和苍凉壮阔。

natural: the water towns south of the Yangtze

meaning.en: The land of rivers, canals and small towns south of the lower Yangtze.
meaning.zh: 长江下游以南河网密布的地区。

examples.zh: 周庄是典型的江南水乡。
examples.en: Zhouzhuang is a typical water town of the south.

examples.zh: 江南水乡，小桥流水，白墙黛瓦。
examples.en: In the water towns of the south: small bridges, flowing streams, white walls and grey tiles.

examples.zh: 他从小在江南水乡长大。
examples.en: He grew up in the canal country of the south.

usage.en: Noun phrase, evokes canals, boats, white walls and grey tiles.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，令人联想到河道、乌篷船、白墙黑瓦。

pinyin: xìng huā chūn yǔ jiāng nán
literal: apricot · blossom · spring · rain · river · south
natural: apricot blossoms and misty rain in the south

meaning.en: A picture of the south in spring: blossoms in misty rain.
meaning.zh: 春日江南，杏花盛开，细雨如烟。

equivalents: blossom and misty rain of the south

examples.zh: 杏花烟雨江南，是文人笔下最温柔的春天。
examples.en: Apricot blossoms and misty rain of Jiangnan: the gentlest spring in the scholars' writing.

examples.zh: 他在画里再现了杏花烟雨江南的景象。
examples.en: In his painting he recreated blossoms and misty rain in the south.

examples.zh: 三月去江南，才懂什么叫杏花烟雨江南。
examples.en: Go to the south in March and you will understand apricot blossom and misty rain.

story.en: The Yuan poet Yu Ji wrote 'a dream of the old mountains and rivers; apricot blossom, spring rain, the south of the river' in the song to Ke Jingzhong.
story.zh: 元代虞集《风入松·寄柯敬仲》有“杏花春雨江南”。

date.en: Yuan dynasty, first half of 14th c.

usage.en: Poetic, common in travel copy; usually 杏花烟雨江南 as a name for spring there. The classical form is 杏花春雨江南.
usage.zh: 诗意，旅游文案中常用，多指江南的春景。古典说法为“杏花春雨江南”。

text: 五岳归来不看山，黄山归来不看岳
pinyin: wǔ yuè guī lái bù kàn shān, huáng shān guī lái bù kàn yuè
literal: five · peaks · return · not · look at · mountains, Huangshan · return · not · look at · peaks
natural: after the Five Peaks, other mountains don't impress; after Huangshan, the Five Peaks don't either

meaning.en: Huangshan is so beautiful that after seeing it no other mountain seems worth seeing.
meaning.zh: 黄山风景极美，看过之后别的山都觉得逊色。

equivalents: once you have seen Huangshan, you need see no other

examples.zh: 五岳归来不看山，黄山归来不看岳，这话一点也不夸张。
examples.en: After the Five Peaks no mountain impresses and after Huangshan no peak does; it's no exaggeration.

examples.zh: 登上黄山，才知道什么叫黄山归来不看岳。
examples.en: Only after climbing Huangshan did I learn what 'after Huangshan no peak is worth seeing' means.

examples.zh: 导游笑着说：黄山归来不看岳，你们一定要去。
examples.en: The guide said with a smile: after Huangshan no peak compares, you must go.

usage.en: A tourism cliché, popularly attributed to Xu Xiake (not in his writings). Both halves are often quoted alone.
usage.zh: 旅游常用语，常被说成明代徐霞客所言（其著作中并无此句）。两半句也常单独引用。

pinyin: jiǔ zhài guī lái bù kàn shuǐ
literal: Jiuzhai · return · not · look at · water

meaning.en: After seeing Jiuzhaigou's lakes, other waters seem ordinary.
meaning.zh: 看过九寨沟的湖水，别处的水就觉得平常了。

equivalents: after Jiuzhai, all other lakes seem dull

examples.zh: 九寨归来不看水，这里的湖水五彩斑斓。
examples.en: After Jiuzhai no water compares; the lakes here are every colour.

examples.zh: 朋友推荐我去看看，说九寨归来不看水。
examples.en: My friend urged me to go, saying nothing compares to Jiuzhai's waters.

examples.zh: 九寨归来不看水，黄山归来不看岳，一语中的。
examples.en: After Jiuzhai no water, after Huangshan no peak: it hits the mark.

usage.en: Modern tourism slogan modelled on 黄山归来不看岳; casual-neutral, no classical source.
usage.zh: 现代旅游口号，仿“黄山归来不看岳”而来；口语或中性，无古典出处。

synonyms: 五岳归来不看山，黄山归来不看岳

natural: fishing boats singing in the evening

meaning.en: A peaceful scene of fishing boats returning at dusk, the fishermen singing.
meaning.zh: 傍晚渔船归来，渔人歌唱，景象宁静。

equivalents: an evening scene of fishermen's songs

examples.zh: 夕阳西下，渔舟唱晚，湖面一片金黄。
examples.en: The sun sets and fishing boats sing at dusk; the lake is all gold.

examples.zh: 古筝曲《渔舟唱晚》旋律优美。
examples.en: The guzheng piece 'Fishing Boats Singing at Dusk' has a lovely melody.

examples.zh: 渔舟唱晚的景象，让他想起了故乡。
examples.en: The scene of fishing boats singing at dusk reminded him of his hometown.

story.en: Wang Bo's 'Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng' says: 'Fishing boats sing in the evening, their echoes reaching the shore of Pengli Lake'.
story.zh: 王勃《滕王阁序》：“渔舟唱晚，响穷彭蠡之滨。”

usage.en: Also the name of a famous guzheng piece. Literary; peaceful, picturesque.
usage.zh: 也是著名古筝曲名。书面语，宁静如画。

meaning.en: Cooking smoke rising gently from village houses.
meaning.zh: 做饭的烟缓缓升起，农村傍晚的景象。

equivalents: smoke curling up from the chimneys

examples.zh: 傍晚的村庄，炊烟袅袅，鸡鸣犬吠。
examples.en: In the evening the village has smoke curling up, hens clucking and dogs barking.

examples.zh: 远远望见炊烟袅袅，就知道快到家了。
examples.en: Seeing wisps of smoke from afar, he knew he was nearly home.

examples.zh: 炊烟袅袅的农家小院，是他最难忘的记忆。
examples.en: The farm courtyard with its curling smoke is his most unforgettable memory.

usage.en: Typical rural-evening and nostalgic image; literary, common in essays.
usage.zh: 典型的田园傍晚和乡愁意象；书面语，常见于作文。

meaning.en: Peaceful rural scenery of fields, orchards and villages.
meaning.zh: 农村田野、村庄的宁静风光。

examples.zh: 周末去郊外，享受田园风光。
examples.en: At the weekend we went to the countryside to enjoy the pastoral scenery.

examples.zh: 这里的田园风光让城里人流连忘返。
examples.en: City people linger here, enchanted by the rural scenery.

examples.zh: 画家常以田园风光为题材。
examples.en: Painters often take pastoral scenery as their subject.

usage.en: Noun phrase, often in travel and real-estate writing; peaceful and nostalgic.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，常见于旅游和楼盘文案；宁静怀旧。

synonyms: 绿树村边合，青山郭外斜

text: 江南好，风景旧曾谙。日出江花红胜火，春来江水绿如蓝
pinyin: jiāng nán hǎo, fēng jǐng jiù céng ān, rì chū jiāng huā hóng shèng huǒ, chūn lái jiāng shuǐ lǜ rú lán
variants: 日出江花红胜火，春来江水绿如蓝
literal: river · south · good, scenery · old · once · familiar. sun · rises · river · flowers · red · surpass · fire, spring · comes · river · water · green · like · indigo
natural: The south is lovely, its scenery long familiar: at sunrise the riverside flowers are redder than fire, and in spring the river is as green as indigo

meaning.en: A famous description of Jiangnan in spring: blazing red blossoms and deep green water.
meaning.zh: 描写江南春天风光：红花如火，江水碧绿。

equivalents: the splendour of spring in the south

examples.zh: 江南好，风景旧曾谙，每到春天我就想起这句词。
examples.en: 'The south is lovely and its scenery familiar': every spring I think of this line.

examples.zh: 看着日出江花红胜火，春来江水绿如蓝，我们都沉醉了。
examples.en: Watching the flowers redder than fire and the river as green as indigo, we were all entranced.

examples.zh: 课文里“日出江花红胜火，春来江水绿如蓝”写得色彩鲜明。
examples.en: In the textbook, the line about flowers redder than fire and water as green as indigo is vividly coloured.

story.en: The first of Bai Juyi's three 'Remembering Jiangnan' poems, written in his later years in Luoyang, recalling the years he spent as governor of Hangzhou and Suzhou; it ends 'Can I not remember Jiangnan?'
story.zh: 白居易晚年在洛阳所作《忆江南》三首之一，追忆任杭州、苏州刺史时的江南；结句为“能不忆江南？”

usage.en: A set text in schools; quoted for spring scenery of the south. The first line 江南好，风景旧曾谙 may be cited alone.
usage.zh: 学校课文，常引用来写江南春景。首句“江南好，风景旧曾谙”也可单独引用。

pinyin: shǔ dào zhī nán, nán yú shàng qīng tiān
literal: Shu · road · of · hardship, harder · than · climbing · blue · sky
natural: the road to Shu is harder than climbing to heaven

meaning.en: The mountain road into Sichuan is harder to travel than climbing the sky; used for any very difficult journey or task.
meaning.zh: 蜀道艰险，比登天还难；也比喻极难做到的事。

examples.zh: 古人说蜀道之难，难于上青天，现在高铁一路通了。
examples.en: The ancients said the road to Shu was harder than climbing the sky; now high-speed rail runs all the way.

examples.zh: 蜀道难，难于上青天，当年翻越秦岭谈何容易。
examples.en: 'The road to Shu is hard, harder than ascending to heaven'; crossing the Qinling Mountains was never easy then.

examples.zh: 要在三天内完成，真是蜀道之难，难于上青天。
examples.en: To finish in three days is harder than climbing to heaven.

story.en: Li Bai's yuefu poem 'Hard Is the Road to Shu' repeats: 'Alas! How dangerous, how high! The road to Shu is harder than climbing to heaven'.
story.zh: 李白乐府诗《蜀道难》：“噫吁嚱，危乎高哉！蜀道之难，难于上青天！”

usage.en: Quoted for rugged routes and also figuratively for very hard tasks. Original line is 蜀道之难，难于上青天; 蜀道难 is the poem's title.
usage.zh: 用来形容道路险阻，也比喻事情极其困难。原句为“蜀道之难，难于上青天”，“蜀道难”是诗题。
